options.opa: A molecule of an organic nature, necessary for the activity of an enzyme.
options.opb: The inorganic part of an enzyme.
options.opc: A molecule of a protein nature, necessary for the activity of an enzyme.
options.opd: Any molecule of a non-vitamin nature that contributes to increase the activity of an enzyme.
options.ope: An allosteric effect that modifies the spatial configuration of enzymes.
